name: The Other Side Bar and Grill
notes: HELD, NOT LOADED. This is the SIGNATURE COCKTAILS board only - a photograph of the printed in-house menu, so the prices are dine-in and trustworthy. It is deliberately not filed: the restaurant is a wings-and-tacos bar & grill, a drinks-only capture is the wrong section shape, and loading it would write status=found and retire the food menu from the queue forever. Load only alongside a food menu. No food menu is published anywhere online as of 2026-09-07: no website (Google shows 'Add website'), not on DoorDash/UberEats/Grubhub search, Yelp serves nothing to curl, and the Google 'Menu & highlights' panel carries one promo item. Same address as Emiliano's Mexican Restaurant and Cantina (id 7386, Ste E) and same ownership - do NOT copy Emiliano's 172 dishes here, the bar runs its own kitchen menu. Also seen: a $20 Wing Combo promo (10 OMG wings any sauce + 16oz draft, dine-in only, 3-7pm daily, 21+) - a limited-time deal, not a menu line.
